item.title: Self-Hosted Mail Statistics Dashboards — Mailgraph vs PFLogSummit vs MailWatch
item.description: Monitoring email server performance and traffic patterns is essential for maintaining reliable mail infrastructure. Whether you’re running Postfix, Sendmail, or another MTA, having visibility into mail volume, delivery rates, and queue sizes helps you identify problems before they impact users.
